integrity: The phase portrait is proved from the exact piecewise-linear trust-region subproblem. The bundled exact-rational replay is a consistency check rather than an infinite proof. The critical cycle uses admissible tie choices; the supercritical cycles use unique subproblem minimizers.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional exact-subproblem, constant-radius analysis for a quadratic smooth term plus absolute-value regularizer. It does not cover multidimensional sparse quadratics, stochastic momentum, approximate subproblem solves, or variable radii.
title: Sharp fixed-radius phase transition for composite trust-region gradient descent
